mod1440_records_of.of_c_rep_hc_grp: §gHigh Command  ·  his army group of 128 armies§!

manual: Battles won and lost, states and victory points taken: they need fighting; a marshal's battles under him need a general's battle
A general the game made up: he shows the unknown leader
A captured general, an admiral's ship kinds: they need a war or a fleet
Two army groups with divisions in one state: the likely link (decision 6)
checklist: 1. The page in the steel look: the filters' card (14,116 1006x46) with seven buttons All ... Order of battle and, behind a rule, the gold checkbox 'Army names'; the list's card (14,168 1006x1038) with the column heads in its head band (Officer, 'N listed', Skill, the four level icons, Traits, Div, Won, Lost, Medals); 20 rows of 48 in sight, the list scrolls to its end with the wheel; the file in five steel cards at x 1026, 640 wide; the title strip and tabs unchanged

2. Army name (1.19.4.1, patched): with Army names ticked, a general's row reads 'General  .  <army name>' and his file's dark field shows the army's name in white; compare three generals with the army names in the game's army bar (hover the army's badge). Untick: 'army of N divisions' in the rows, 'Army of N divisions' in the file; Army Readiness's Army names button shows the same setting (one switch). Note what a field marshal leading an army group reads (his rows say 'Army group of N armies' and never ask the property)

3. Chain of command: effect mod1440_chk_e2_oob (tools/check_effects.py) and read game.log: for each general with troops, his state and count, and for each field marshal leading an army group 'num_units_in_state' in that state. Write down whether a marshal's num_units_in_state counts his generals' divisions (state method) and, from the same effect, whether is_leading_army_in_province with include_field_marshal = yes is true for the general's provinces (province method) and whether 'province = var:' is accepted

4. Without an army group at the start: form one (select two armies, create an army group, assign a field marshal), run one day: filter Order of battle lists the marshal with his generals indented under him, then the armies under the High Command, then the fleets; compare with the game's theatre boxes (army group letter, armies by number); move a general to another army group, one day: he moves too

5. The marshal's file: the Chain of command card (Under his command: divisions = his num_units, Won/Lost of his armies since the build ran, 'since <date>'), up to five generals with face, name (click: his file), army, Div, Won, Lost, Skill, the green mark; Traits, Service record and the diary stand 62 lower and the diary shows 5 lines. Click a general's name: his file, 'Reports to <marshal>  .  army group of N armies' (click: the marshal's file)

6. A battle counted for a marshal: effect mod1440_chk_e2_battle (a won and a lost battle of a general linked to a marshal through the hooks' own effects), then mod1440_chk_e2_log: the marshal's gwon and glost are 1 each and his chain card's line shows them. With fighting: whether a field marshal gets on_army_leader_won_combat himself when one of his generals fights (his own Won rises too: write it down; Witzleben read Won 2 in the user's game)

7. Traits: 'N of M chosen' against the trait tree (num_assigned_traits against the chosen traits, num_max_traits against the slots: Model 2, Rundstedt 1); the green mark in the row and 'a trait can be chosen' in the file against the game's own marker on the general (a leader with free experience and a slot); mod1440_chk_e2_log prints both numbers and whether he has a free slot for every leader

8. Trait tooltips: hover a trait icon in a row and an icon and a name in the file: the trait's name in yellow, its kind, its effects with the game's own names in green or red, and its description; compare Cautious and Old Guard with the game's own trait tooltip in the general's window; newlines and colours must render (no '\n' or section signs shown). Another mod's trait: 'its effects are in the game's own tooltip'

9. Command card of a general: Divisions, Battalions, In battle (tooltip attacking/defending), Planning ('no battle plan' while he has none; draw a battle plan, wait two days: the percentage against the army badge's planning bar), Entrenchment, Battle plans, Infantry, Armoured (against the division badges of his army: a panzer division counts), Motorised, Mechanised, Other kinds, Equipped (against Army Readiness's Equipped of the same army)
10. Stands in: the state where most of his divisions stand and 'HQ in <state>' (or 'HQ not deployed') as Army Readiness's row says; the go-to button and Show on map move the camera there
11. Equipment: the Records close and Army Readiness opens with that general's army chosen (its row lit, the equipment list of the army)

12. Service record: the banded table (Battles won ... Points lost; Commissioned, Promoted to field marshal for a marshal only, Last skill level, From a division, Decorations); Award... shows the country's medals over the service record and the diary (two columns of plates, rows of 60); award one: the rack shows it at 0.6 with its name and date after it and in the tooltip; Take back last

13. An admiral (Raeder): manoeuvring and coordination icons in the level row, 'Fleet' and 'N ships' in the field, Ships and the four ship kinds in the Command table; no Reports to, no Stands in, no Equipment

14. error.log: no line that names the mod, no 'invalid scope for var' (mod1440_of_fm, mod1440_of_c_fm, mod1440_of_c_loc, mod1440_of_c_hq), no unknown trigger is_promoted_from_unit, no 'Not a valid value', no 'Could not find sprite type' (GFX_1440p_OF_*, GFX_1440p_SG_rule_2x30, the new hit, stripe and pick sprites), no missing localisation mod1440_tre_*
E7: every row's face and the file's face are the officer's own as the game's Officer Corps shows him; the chain card's faces at 23x31
